visual_identity.body: Slender, vibrant lizard with a long, tapering tail. Skin has a soft, beaded texture with high-fidelity scale patterns.
visual_identity.coloration: Electric lime green with 'Maroon' spots along the spine to stand out against 'Pale lavender' rocks.
visual_identity.face: Large, rotating 'chameleon-style' eyes with bright gold irises. A friendly, slight curve to the mouth line.

personality: Darting, curious, and slightly shy. It tilts its head and sticks out a tiny forked tongue to 'taste' the air.
